title: Final Testament Truth
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji had not yet recovered from the shock, the Tianji Record suddenly vibrated violently, as if sensing an existence connected to his destiny—the twin brother he had never met was quietly descending into the world.

text.content: The blood-stained cloth trembled slightly between Chen Ji's fingers, as if carrying his father's final breath. He held his breath, deciphering the blurry ink stroke by stroke—it was his father Chen Xuan's handwriting, familiar to him down to his bones. As the candlelight flickered, the bloodstains on the cloth gleamed with a dark red luster, like some ominous omen. Chen Ji's throat tightened; he had too many questions to ask, too much resentment to vent, but his father's final testament on the cloth was revealing a truth he had never imagined.

"Ji'er, if you are reading this letter, it means your father is no longer among the living." The handwriting on the cloth was intermittent, some places soaked through with blood, nearly illegible. Chen Ji's fingertips slid slowly along those characters, as if trying to touch the warmth of his father's writing. The ink was sometimes neat, sometimes hasty—one could imagine how weak and desperate his father was when writing this letter. Every stroke felt like carving flesh from his heart, yet he forced himself to continue reading.

"The Tianji Record is no divine object, but a forbidden technique that seizes creation from heaven and earth. Every time you use its power of foresight, you are borrowing from fate—when your Heavenly Fate Value is exhausted, that is the day you die." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, a chill crawling from his tailbone straight to the crown of his head. He looked down at his own hands—the Tianji Record Fragment he had regarded as his greatest reliance was now like a sword hanging over his head. He had always thought he was consuming some虚无缥缈的 "Heavenly Fate Value," never knowing this was actually透支 his lifespan and fate.

dialogue.content: (Cold laugh) So that's how it is... Father, what you left me wasn't some reverse-heavenly opportunity, but a poison wrapped in honey!

choice.prompt: After learning the true cost of the Tianji Record, Chen Ji faced his first choice:

choices.description: No matter how cruel the truth, he needed to know everything. Running away wouldn't solve anything. Since Father left this letter, there must be something more important to convey.
choices.risk_hint: May reveal even more unacceptable truths

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the surging emotions. His fingers had stopped trembling, replaced by an almost cold tranquility. The more critical the moment, the more he needed to remain calm. Father would never just leave behind bad news before passing away—there must still be something he needed in this letter.

choices.description: This letter is simply a curse! Why must Father burden him with such a heavy responsibility? He had the right to be angry, the right to refuse this so-called destiny.

text.content: Chen Ji fiercely crumpled the cloth into a ball, his knuckles white from the force. But just as he was about to let go, the blood-stained bundle actually flickered with a faint light, a familiar force enveloping him—that was the aura of the Tianji Record. His father's aura. He froze on the spot, his fist clenching and unclenching, finally slowly spreading the cloth out again. Whether he wanted it or not, fate had already pushed him to this point.

choices.description: Mo Xiansheng was Father's chess guardian—he must know more about the inside story. Before making a decision, he needed more information from his master.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may not be completely honest

text.content: Chen Ji's mind moved, and the first page of the Tianji Record glowed faintly. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul phantom slowly emerged, but only watched him quietly, eyes filled with complex emotions. "You finally saw that letter." Mo Xiansheng's voice was aged and weary, "But there are some things this old man cannot tell you too much about. The timing hasn't come; knowing too much will only plunge you into greater danger."

Chen Ji steadied his mind again, his gaze falling on the lower part of the cloth. The bloodstains gradually thinned, and the handwriting became clearer—Father's bold strokes revealed a resolve: "Father exhausted my entire life to finally piece together the truth of the Tianji Record's fragments. This technique did not come from nowhere; it was created by ancient great ones at the cost of their lives. There is only one way to break its poison—Fate's Twin Born." Chen Ji's breath caught suddenly. Twin Born? What did that mean?

"The Tianji Record is incomplete; its complete version requires the Twin Born of Fate as the key." Father's handwriting visibly trembled when writing到这里, the ink bleeding and smearing, as if his state of mind was greatly disturbed at this point. Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently, a terrifying thought exploding in his mind—Fate's Twin Born. He was not an only child; he had a twin brother! That brother he had never met, whom he had believed dead long ago, actually held the key to the complete Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: (Hoarse voice) So... from the very beginning, my purpose for existing was to become a chess piece?

text.content: The handwriting on the cloth did not stop because of Chen Ji's turmoil. Father continued: "Ji'er, Father knows you have another brother. During the family's dramatic change, to protect you, I sent him away. His whereabouts are unknown to this day. But there is one thing you must remember—your fates are connected. When one prospers, both prosper; when one falls, both fall. If he dies, you will also live with difficulty; if you forcefully seek the complete Tianji Record, he is the best sacrifice." Chen Ji felt the world spinning before his eyes, as if everything was collapsing.

Chen Ji's fingernails dug deeply into his palms, blood dripping through his fingers, yet he was oblivious. His mind kept flashing to that never-met figure—his twin brother. They shared the same blood, bore the same destiny, yet were forced apart from the moment of birth. What Father called "protection" had merely turned them into two pieces interdependent on each other. The curse of the Tianji Record was carved into their very blood and bones from the start.

choice.prompt: Facing this truth enough to overturn his understanding, Chen Ji had to make a choice:

choices.description: Since their fates are connected, take the initiative. He wanted to find that brother he had never met. Perhaps by joining forces, they could break this damn chess game.
choices.visible_reward: Gain possibility of breaking the curse
choices.risk_hint: The other party may already be controlled by hostile forces

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, the confusion in his eyes gradually replaced by a cold resolve. Since fate wanted him to be a chess piece, he would become the one who moves the pieces. He would find his twin brother—not to be manipulated by fate, but to personally cut off this damn chain. His fist slowly clenched, his knuckles cracking.

choices.text: First find Chen Nian to confirm
choices.description: Sister Chen Nian was taken by the Holy Sect; perhaps she knows some clues about the twins. Moreover, her existence interferes with the Tianji Record's foresight—this in itself is a kind of abnormality.
choices.risk_hint: Rescuing Chen Nian will be extremely difficult

text.content: Chen Ji's mind flashed to Chen Nian's figure. That sister taken away by the Holy Sect, that mysterious existence who could interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight. Was she also a piece on this chessboard? Father said in the letter that he sent the twin brother away during the family change—what about Chen Nian? What role did she play in this setup? Countless questions circled in his mind, yet he could find no definite answer.

choices.description: Mo Xiansheng was Father's guardian; he must know the whereabouts of the twin. The master has been hiding something all along. Now is the time to make him confess.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may have his own difficulties

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, a sharp light flashing in his eyes. He activated the Tianji Record once more, and Mo Xiansheng's phantom appeared again. This time, Chen Ji gave him no chance to evade: "Mo Xiansheng, I ask you one more time—where is my twin brother?" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly,沉默了许久，终于叹了口气："少爷，有些事，老夫真的不能说。不是不愿，是不能……"

At this moment, the last few lines on the cloth came into Chen Ji's view. Father's handwriting had become extremely weak, as if he had used his very last strength: "Ji'er, Father owes you too much. But there is one thing you must know—your twin brother, his life格与你相反。He is of Pure Yang physique, and you are of Pure Yin body. The Tianji Record requires Yin-Yang harmony to be complete, and you two are precisely the final key."

Chen Ji's breathing grew rapid. Pure Yin body, Pure Yang body, Yin-Yang harmony—these terms constantly collided in his mind. Father's meaning was already crystal clear: the Tianji Record's completeness requires the two brothers to merge with their lives. Not cooperation, not mutual benefit, but—fusion. One person's existence must be completely erased to bring the Tianji Record to completion. He felt a bone-deep chill, as if seeing his own final outcome.

However, at this moment, the Tianji Record suddenly vibrated violently. Chen Ji looked down to see the ancient book glowing with a ghostly light shaking frantically, the runes on its surface twisting and moving like living things, as if sensing something. Then, a dazzling golden light shot out from the pages, coalescing in mid-air into a blurry image—a figure bearing a striking resemblance to Chen Ji, yet more masculine and fierce, staring coldly at him.

choice.prompt: That figure bearing a striking resemblance to Chen Ji suddenly appeared, and Chen Ji had to react:

choices.text: Take the initiative to speak and ask
choices.description: Since fate has brought them together in this way, let's first hear what he has to say. Know yourself and know your enemy, and you will be invincible.
choices.risk_hint: The other party may set a trap

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the churning emotions in his heart, and spoke: "Are you... my twin brother?" The figure in the golden light did not answer, only watching him silently, eyes flashing with complex light—scrutiny, doubt, and an indefinable emotion. After a moment, that figure slowly spoke, voice low and cold: "The bond between you and me runs deeper than you can imagine."

choices.description: This may be a trap. Anything that appears suddenly is worthy of suspicion, especially an existence so clearly connected to his fate.

text.content: Chen Ji did not act rashly; instead, he stepped back, fingers quietly gripping the edge of the Tianji Record. He coldly stared at that figure, the spiritual energy in his body already building up and ready to strike. Whether this was a phantom or a real person, he would not easily trust. Fate had taught him too many lessons—behind every seemingly precious gift hides a price enough to be fatal.

choices.description: Friend or foe, let's test his strength first. In this world, strength is the only trustworthy thing.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the other party's strength information

text.content: A cold light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, and several fierce sword qi shot out from the Tianji Record, directly at that golden figure. However, to everyone's shock, those attacks sufficient to slay a Condensation Qi cultivator disappeared without a trace the moment they touched that figure, like mud ox entering the sea. That figure stood motionless, even its gaze remaining unchanging, only speaking calmly: "Is this your means?" The tone carried a hint of disappointment.

That golden figure stared at Chen Ji for a moment, then finally spoke again: "We were originally of the same source, yet forcibly separated by fate. Now the time has come; the bond between us can no longer be blocked." Before the words finished, that figure abruptly transformed into a streak of golden light, shooting directly into the Tianji Record. In an instant, Chen Ji felt a surge of vast power from the ancient book, as if something long dormant was awakening. The pages of the Tianji Record flipped frantically, golden light and ghostly light intertwining, the entire secret chamber bathed in this eerie glow.

Chen Ji endured the intense dizziness, staring fixedly at the constantly trembling Tianji Record in his hand. He could feel this ancient book undergoing some earth-shaking change—the originally blurry runes on the pages were becoming clear one by one, and simultaneously, fragmented images kept flashing through his mind: an infant in swaddling clothes hastily carried away; an old hand carving some mark on the infant's chest; and a blurry voice murmuring: "Twin Born... must not meet... otherwise..."

The violent vibration lasted a full cup of tea's time before finally subsiding. Chen Ji gasped for breath, his clothes already soaked through with cold sweat. He looked down at the Tianji Record—only to find the ancient book had become much thicker, and a row of faintly visible golden characters had appeared on the cover: "Tianji Record·Twin Born Chapter." And on the last page, a new entry was slowly emerging: "Fate's Twin Born have sensed each other. Complete version unlock progress: one-tenth."

Chen Ji stared blankly at that line, his heart filled with mixed emotions. He did not know where his twin brother was now, did not know whether he was enemy or friend, and did not know what changes this sudden "sensing" would bring to their destiny. But he clearly knew one thing—from this moment on, an invisible chain tightly bound him together with that person he had never met. Whether he wished it or not, their fates had intertwined into an inseparable whole. And behind all this, how many secrets did he not yet know?
